name: Grid Ops Demo
description: The VR Grid-tab paint palette made visible: six 8x8 heightfield grids, each applying one GridOps operation (raise/pyramid, randomize with seed, checker, frame, ring, ground-plane). GridOps (commons/modifiers/grid_ops.gd) is the GDScript port of the web /editor mutators — the same paint ops the headset Grid tab will use. Step 1 of the unified editing-panel work.
theoreticalGrounding: Editing the grid is painting a heightfield; the op is the brush. add/raise push structure (F), randomize pushes variety (E), ground-plane normalizes back to order.

grid_ops_demo.name: Grid Ops Demo
grid_ops_demo.description: Six labelled heightfield grids demonstrating GridOps: raise(pyramid), randomize(seed), checker, frame, ring, ground-plane. Heights rendered as colour-graded cubes. DNA: none (static demo).
grid_ops_demo.qfep_connection: lambda: grid paint ops tend the structure — variety in (E), plane back (F).
